color_palette.background: Warm Beige/Sand with a subtle wavy pattern
color_palette.text_primary: Dark Brown (e.g., for 'Start Your Skin Reset.')
color_palette.text_secondary: Muted Gold/Brown (e.g., for 'These are not flaws')
color_palette.accents: White (for call-to-action button text and 'OG GLOW GOD' badge text)

background_layer.elements: Soft, flowing, organic wave pattern in a slightly darker beige tone across the bottom half of the background.

hero_element.description: Split-face portrait of a young woman with dark hair.

left_side.condition: Shows skin concerns: oily T-zone, uneven patches, tanning, and textured skin on the cheek.
left_side.annotations: Four white lines with circles pointing to specific areas with text labels: 'Oily here?', 'Uneven here?', 'Tanned here?', 'Texture here?'.

right_side.condition: Shows clear, smooth, and radiant skin.
right_side.product_placement: A jar of 'Kurikoottu Herbal Face Pack' is positioned next to her clear cheek, implying the cause of the transformation.
right_side.product_details: The jar is glass with a golden lid and a label featuring the brand name, product name 'Kurikoottu', and 'Herbal Face Pack'.

logo_top.icon: A stylized leaf inside a circle, placed to the right of the text.

badge_bottom_left.shape: Rectangular badge with rounded corners and a star icon.
badge_bottom_left.style: White outline and text on the beige background.

main_title.text:
These are not flaws
These are signals
Start Your Skin Reset.
main_title.style: The first two lines are in a lighter, muted brown. The final line, 'Start Your Skin Reset.', is larger and in a prominent dark brown, creating a strong contrast and call to action.

button.shape: Rounded rectangle button with a white border and text.

annotation_labels.style: Clean, simple sans-serif font in white.

design_core.type: Social Media Promotional Ad / B2B Manufacturing Concept

color_palette.background: Soft gradient transitioning from Warm Summer Yellow (#FFF9C4) to Crisp Autumn Peach/White (#FFE0B2)
color_palette.product_accent: Rose Gold and Frosted Glass for the serum bottle

background_layer.elements: A seamlessly divided background. The left side features subtle, glowing sun rays (representing harsh Summer). The right side features a soft, translucent autumn leaf casting a gentle shadow (representing clear Autumn).
background_layer.lighting: Bright, airy, natural sunlight effect to emphasize the 'mỏng nhẹ' (lightweight) feel of the product.

hero_element_3d.description: A sleek, premium frosted glass dropper or pump bottle sitting centrally on a pristine white marble podium.
hero_element_3d.texture_detail: A styled smear of the actual serum texture is visible beside the bottle—showing it as a milky, lightweight fluid with a slight pinkish tint to visualize the 'Tone-Up' effect.

floating_props.description: A translucent, glowing 3D shield or dome gently enveloping the bottle, symbolizing absolute UV protection.
A delicate white feather gently floating in the background, reinforcing the weightless/lightweight texture.

main_headline.text:
Gia Công Serum Chống Nắng
Mỏng Nhẹ, Nâng Tone
main_headline.style: Elegant, modern sans-serif. The words 'Mỏng Nhẹ, Nâng Tone' are highlighted in a glowing Rose Gold color to draw the eye.

sub_headline.text: Dù ngày Hè nắng gắt hay tiết Thu trong vắt... Tia UV vẫn luôn hiện diện.
sub_headline.english_meaning: Whether harsh summer sun or clear autumn days... UV rays are always present.
sub_headline.style: Medium weight, italicized for a smooth, informative tone.

solution_statement.text: Serum chống nắng Vimac - Lựa chọn vô cùng sáng suốt!
solution_statement.english_meaning: Vimac Sunscreen Serum - An incredibly wise choice!
solution_statement.style: Bold, clean font encased in a soft, pill-shaped badge at the bottom center.

marketing_focus.strategy: Visualizing a year-round necessity. By showcasing both Summer and Autumn lighting, the design communicates to potential cosmetic clients that this 'Vimac' formula is a versatile, all-season product for their brand.

design_core.product_name: Body Love Restoring Care Hand Cream

color_palette.background: Soft white to light grey gradient
color_palette.organic_tones: Earthy browns, warm beiges (almonds/coconut), and vibrant green (leaves)

background_layer.elements: Clean studio backdrop dominated by a massive, bold typographic element ('CREAM') that grounds the floating composition.

hero_element.description: A tube of Dove Restoring Care Hand Cream
hero_element.position: Tilted diagonally across the center of the frame, creating dynamic movement.
hero_element.details: The tube features the gold Dove 'Body Love' heart and bird logo, with a brown color band indicating the coconut/almond variant.

floating_props.description: A stylized, fluid splash of white cream erupting from behind the top half of the tube, visually representing the 'almond milk' ingredient and smooth texture.
Several whole, raw almonds dynamically bursting out from the cream splash.
A realistic, textured half-coconut resting at the bottom center, anchoring the composition.
floating_props.accents: A couple of bright green palm/fern fronds sprouting from behind the coconut to add freshness.

background_typography.style: Giant, bold, uppercase sans-serif in solid black, partially obscured by the 3D elements.

top_left.title: Body Love Restoring Care Hand Cream
top_left.body: Help restore dry hands with our nourishing coconut oil and almond milk-infused hand cream, inspired by Indian rituals.

bottom_left_badge.border_text: This product is cargo certified • This product is cargo certified •

brand_logos.on_product: Dove logo in blue, 'body love' in gold with heart/bird emblem.

color_palette.accents: Crisp white and off-white (spa towel, gloves, and device)

background_layer.elements: Solid, untextured warm beige studio backdrop designed to create a calming, premium atmosphere while providing ample negative space for the text.

hero_element.description: Close-up profile portrait of a relaxed woman receiving a facial treatment.
hero_element.pose: Lying down with eyes closed, facing upwards and slightly to the left.
hero_element.details: The subject is wearing a white terry cloth spa headband. Her facial skin is visibly coated with a smooth, semi-transparent treatment gel or serum. A practitioner's hand, wearing off-white medical gloves, holds a sleek white Hydrafacial wand device, pressing it gently against the subject's forehead.

logo_area.style: Clean, modern sans-serif in dark brown.

lead_in.style: Medium-weight sans-serif, dark brown, smaller font size.

main_title.style: Bold, large-scale sans-serif, dark brown, stacked on two lines.

headlines.placement: Left-aligned, positioned naturally in the upper-middle negative space above the subject's face.

color_palette.product_accents: Dusty rose / nude pink (product tube, lip color, and texture swatch)

background_layer.elements: Solid, untextured soft off-white studio backdrop designed to keep the focus entirely on the product texture and the model's features.

hero_element.description: Close-up beauty portrait of a woman (right half of the face visible) with glowing skin and highly glossy, nude-pink lips.
hero_element.pose: Looking directly at the camera. Her hand is elegantly holding the matte pink cylindrical lip gloss tube in the foreground, creating depth.

product_swatch.description: A realistic, glossy smear of the lip gloss shade floating in the middle-left negative space.
product_swatch.accents: Framed by four thin, minimalist black corner crop marks.

brand_badge.style: Black sans-serif text inside a dusty rose, slightly metallic-looking rectangular badge with rounded corners.

main_title.style: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif for 'БЛЕСК', followed by medium-weight sans-serif for 'для губ'. Solid black.

body_copy.text:
Совершенный нюд для безупречного
макияжа на каждый день.
body_copy.english_meaning: The perfect nude for flawless everyday makeup.
body_copy.style: Clean, light sans-serif, dark grey, positioned below the headline.

swatch_label.style: Small, clean sans-serif text centered directly above the glossy swatch.

product_packaging.style: Bold black sans-serif printed vertically along the matte pink tube.
